Game Overview

Big Fish Eat Small Fish is a two-player title where dive into the aquatic world where size matters. Gobble up smaller fish to grow in strength, and challenge friends in thrilling two-player mode. Explore an ever-changing ocean as you swim, evade, and strategize your way to becoming the biggest fish in the sea.
